title: NovoFab Semi-Automatic Hydraulic Band Saws — Value Line | NovoTech
meta_description: NovoFab Machinery semi-automatic band saws in Canada: NF-H 10 S/10 T hydraulic pivot saws, NF-H 13 twin-mitre, NF-H 16, NF-H 12 SC single-column with touch screen and the 18″ NF-H 18. Specs in inches and mm.
intro: Hydraulic saws for the production floor at value-line prices: a hydraulic cylinder lowers the bow at a dialled-in rate, the vise clamps hydraulically on most models, and the bow lifts and the machine stops at the end of the cut. From the 10-inch NF-H 10 S to the 18-inch NF-H 18 swivel-head saw, with a single-column touch-screen model (NF-H 12 SC) in between.
hero_points: Hydraulic descent, automatic bow return and shut-off
Twin-mitre bows (45° both sides, 60° right) on the NF-H 10 T, 13 and 18
Round capacities from Ø10″ (254 mm) to Ø18″ (460 mm)
hero_brand_line: NovoFab Machinery is NovoTech's own value line: proven designs built to our specification, with CSA-approved panels, a 1-year warranty and parts and support from Mississauga.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoFab Machinery semi-automatic band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between a semi-automatic and a fully automatic band saw?
faq.a: A semi-automatic saw makes one cut per start: it clamps, cuts and lifts the bow, then waits for the operator to feed the next piece. A fully automatic saw also feeds the material to length and repeats the cycle for the programmed quantity — see the NovoFab automatic band saws.

faq.q: Which NovoFab saws cut miters on both sides?
faq.a: The NF-H 10 T, NF-H 13 / 13 C and NF-H 18 swivel to both sides (45° left and right, 60° right). The NF-H 10 S swivels to one side (45°–90°) and the NF-H 16 cuts angles up to 60° on one side.

Single column: the NF-H 12 SC guides the bow vertically on a column instead of a pivot, for square straight cuts up to Ø11-3/4″ / 19-3/4″ × 11-3/4″ with a PLC touch screen. Its automatic sister is the NF-A 12 SC.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
